_about: Public-domain Henry Belfrage (1774-1835), Secession minister of Falkirk, for the Word Hoard: Sacramental Addresses and Meditations, Practical Discourses, Sketches of Life and Character, A Monitor to Families, Discourses on the Duties and Consolations of the Aged, Counsels for the Sanctuary, and A Practical Exposition of the Assembly's Shorter Catechism. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 106 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

belfrage-sacramental-1821: Sacramental Addresses and Meditations: Intended to Aid Devotion, vol. 2 (W. Oliphant, 1821)
belfrage-sketches: Sketches of Life and Character, from Scripture and from Observation (W. Oliphant, 1822)
belfrage-monitor-families: A monitor to families, or, Discourses on some of the duties and scenes of domestic life (Edinburgh : [s.n.], 1824)
belfrage-the-aged: Discourses on the duties and consolations of the aged (Edinburgh : Oliver & Boyd, 1827)
belfrage-counsels-sanctuary: Counsels for the sanctuary and for civil life; or, Discourses to various classes in the Church (Oliver & Boyd, 1829)
belfrage-shorter-catechism: A practical exposition of the Assembly's shorter catechism: exhibiting a system of theology in a popular form, and particularly adapted for family instruction. 2 (catalogued 1835)
